710-4775-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1170-3536-3698-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: Cheering Fanatic does not have summoning sickness. You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3536-3698-5131--202.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name the chosen artifact.
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cheering Fanatic.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact, causing a player to mill three cards
Repeat from step 2

654-4499-7898.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts.
654-4499-7898.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Smaug.
When Smaug enters, its first ability triggers, creating a number of tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the Treasures.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3734-4284.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3734-4284.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Phyrexian Metamorph and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3734-4284.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2634-5148-7735.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Mountain, a basic Island and at least three other basic lands.
2634-5148-7735.description:
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Early Harvest
Resolve the Early Harvest copy, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1850-2167-7705.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a 1/1 Moloid creature token.
Repeat.
1850-2167-7705.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

2049-5147-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2049-5147-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3197-4050-4120-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
3197-4050-4120-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Herd Baloth, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

1394-2060-4050-5902-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Innkeeper's Talent.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-6797-7297.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1456-4871-5220-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1456-4871-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2034-4871-5496-6967-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Honest Rutstein.
Repeat.

997-4681-5170-5933.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

2719-6568-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
2719-6568-7009.description:
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Sakashima of a Thousand Faces. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

1978-5143-5168.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.
1978-5143-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat

339-647-677-5231.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3734-4375-6798.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

63-1651-2585-4013.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters, it triggers twice, creating at least two Clue tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Grim Monolith.
Repeat.
63-1651-2585-4013.notes: Because your opponents must choose to either let themselves and you investigate, or lose life, this combo will very likely result in infinite Clue tokens for you and your opponents.

851-2457-5794-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Frog creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Frog and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

3682-4518-5542-6747.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Kor Skyfisher from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-4927-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4927-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3933-4929-5479-6627.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3933-4929-5479-6627.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting a charge counter on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

2743-5362-6570.description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Quantum Misalignment and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Quantum Misalignment copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2073-2099-6522.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Mandibular Kite from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mandibular Kite enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Mandibular Kite to it.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Mandibular Kite.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

11-3617-5131-6276.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
11-3617-5131-6276.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Time Walk.
Holding priority, activate Slick Imitator by paying {1} and sacrificing it, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Time Walk, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Slick Imitator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
11-3617-5131-6276.notes: If you've cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn, you may move to your extra turn, and then do step 6 followed by steps 1-5.

527-979-3995.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 9 or greater.
527-979-3995.description:
Activate Likeness Looter by paying {3}, causing it to become a copy of Selvala.
Activate Likeness Looter using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {7}{G}{U}.
Activate Likeness Looter by paying {3}, causing it to become a copy of Horseshoe Crab.
Activate Likeness Looter using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

27-1849-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-1849-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1456-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat

4413-4812.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Kederekt Leviathan from your graveyard to the battlefield attached with Animate Dead.
Kederekt Leviathan triggers, returning all nonland permanents to their owner's hands.
Animate Dead triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kederekt Leviathan.
Repeat each turn.
